tools.name: get_current_page
tools.description: Get metadata for the page the user is viewing: path, URL, title, description and heading outline.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get project metadata and links: website, source repository, issues, releases, community, `llms.txt` bundles and versions.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List pages in the documentation navigation with titles, paths, URLs and available descriptions. Use for browsing; use `search_docs` for a specific topic.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a documentation page in the user's browser, optionally at a heading. Returns the page it landed on. Use only when the user asks to navigate; use `read_page` to inspect content without moving them.

hash.description: Heading anchor to scroll to, e.g. '#installation'.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a documentation page as Markdown by route path. Links in it are route paths for this tool. If `truncated`, continue with `nextOffset` as `offset`. Generated pages have no Markdown source.

path.description: Route path of the page, e.g. '/guide/getting-started'.

maxLength.description: Maximum Markdown characters to return (1-40000, default 40000).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search pages and sections in UnDocs. Returns ranked matches with previews, route paths and optional heading anchors. Use `read_page` to read a result.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'deploy to vercel' or 'defineNitroPlugin'.
